title: Move Surface diffusion energy barriers using the Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) method to Sphinx Gallery
body:
I moved the "Surface diffusion energy barriers using the Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) method" tutorial to examples/tutorials sphinx gallery ((See issues: #1778, #1756)) and removed the old legacy tutorials of "Surface diffusion energy barriers using the Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) method" and "NEB: Dissociation of a molecule using the NEB method" (which was already moved to sphinx gallery with https://gitlab.com/ase/ase/-/merge_requests/3824 ).

I removed the static figures of the initial and final states in the tutorial, which were included the old tutorials. Maybe one could include code to generate similar figures if helpful.

The tutorial also has a section discussing parallelizing over NEB images with MPI using e.g. gpaw python. I added the relevant link to the GPAW documentation which explains parallel runs, but maybe this is beyond the scope of this tutorial. I also added `n_images = 1  # Set to number of processes you use with mpiexec` (so effectively a serial run) to make it work with Sphinx-Gallery.
